brief: A consumer-facing name with familiar gene/genetic/DNA and age words, easy spelling, and a direct link to the phrase someone might search. No claim of measured keyword search volume.

scope.apple: Official iTunes software search API, up to 100 fuzzy software results per term. US/GB/BG where listed; normalized exact-name/developer matches checked.
scope.googlePlay: Direct Google Play Apps & Games search in the United States/English, inspected in a real browser.
scope.limits: A dated app-name collision check, not a reservation, trademark clearance, available domain or exhaustive global catalogue.

shortlist.name: GeneticAge
shortlist.meaning: The familiar phrase genetic age, with a single-word brand spelling. The clearest match to the requested search wording.
shortlist.position: Preferred direct/search-oriented direction, with KoleQuant as the distinguishing publisher brand.

shortlist.name: GeneAge
shortlist.caution: GeneAge Predictor already appears in Genome X clinical diagnostics. Do not present the bare name as globally unique.

shortlist.name: AgeNetics
shortlist.meaning: A compact age + genetics wordplay; more brand-like, with the age meaning reinforced by the subtitle.
shortlist.caution: AGenetics Labs is already an agentic-software business using this spelling. No exact app listing was found, but the name is not globally unused.

shortlist.name: GeneYears
shortlist.meaning: Two everyday words: genes and years. More approachable than codon-based terminology.
shortlist.position: The more distinctive consumer-friendly alternative, though less directly aligned with the exact phrase genetic age.

excluded.name: AgeGenetics
excluded.reason: Existing longevity/laboratory-test and supplement brand in a closely related field.

editorialNote: The current app estimates clinical PhenoAge from blood results and offers a health/lifestyle profile. Store descriptions must explain those inputs rather than imply an actual DNA assay or an exact genetic age. Candidates have not been applied to the app.
